newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana Stock Exchange rises in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Ghana Stock Exchange rises in quiet trade.

text.p: Shares on the Ghana Stock Exchange rose in quiet trade on Monday. The All-Share Index gained 1.42 points to 382.73 and analysts said strong corporate results were helping sentiment despite concerns about the overall economy.

"To a large extent, our market is not very sensitive to external factors. Players in the market, especially small investors, are moved by the balance sheets of their companies," said Jonathan Ansong of the Shareholders' Association.
Total market capitalisation climbed to 3,294.89 billion cedis from 3,292.89 billion on Friday. Offers exceeded bids by 949,270 shares to 159,540.
Just 33,040 shares were traded, 24,400 of them in Enterprise Insurance Company which fell 10 cedis to 430.
Friday's volume of 1,213,730 shares was boosted by an institutional investor which bought 1,200,100 shares in car and agricultural equipment distributor Mechanical Lloyd.

The exchange's second biggest equity, Ghana Commercial Bank, continued its firm run, rising nine cedis to 738. Mobil Oil Ghana rose 100 to 6,300, and Fan Milk rose three cedis to 380, and Social Security Bank and Accra Brewery rose one cedi to 1,033 and 506 cedis respectively.
